parameters.name: AckConfig
parameters.description: The ACK cluster configuration.

parameters.name: AdditionalSecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: The list of security group IDs.

parameters.name: AutoCompensateState
parameters.description: The automatic compensation state.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The cluster ID.

parameters.name: CostOptimizedConfig
parameters.description: The cost-optimized mode configuration.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The node group description.

parameters.name: EcsSpotStrategy
parameters.description: The spot instance strategy.

parameters.name: EnableGracefulDecommission
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable graceful decommission. When a cluster is created in V303, graceful decommission is disabled by default for task groups.

parameters.name: InstanceTypeList
parameters.description: The list of ECS instance types.

parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The key pair for ECS logon.

parameters.name: MaxSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of instances in the node group.

parameters.name: MinSize
parameters.description: The minimum number of instances in the node group.

parameters.name: NodeCount
parameters.description: The target number of nodes in the node group.

parameters.name: NodeGroupId
parameters.description: The node group ID.

parameters.name: NodeGroupName
parameters.description: The node group name.

parameters.name: NodeResizeStrategy
parameters.description: The node scale-out strategy. Valid values: COST_OPTIMIZED and PRIORITY. Default value: PRIORITY.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: SpotBidPrices
parameters.description: The maximum bid prices for spot instances. This parameter takes effect only when spotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

parameters.name: SpotInstanceRemedy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable spot instance supplementation. If this feature is enabled, the scaling group attempts to create new instances to replace spot instances that are about to be reclaimed when the system sends a reclamation notification. Default value: false.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.
